title: Java News Roundup: JDK 27, Open J Proxy, A2A Jakarta, Azul Payara, BoxLang, Netflix ja
author: Michael Redlich
description: Highlights the GA release of JDK 27, LibericaJDK 27, Open J Proxy 1.0 and A2A Jakarta 1.0; point releases of Azul Payara, JHipster, JetBrains Ktor and BoxLang; and introduces Netflix ja, a modern JMS command-line development experience for Java developers.

title: Java 27 Delivers Post-Quantum Cryptography, Future Language Innovation, Helidon 27, JavaFX 27
author: Michael Redlich
description: Oracle releases version 27 of Java and the JVM. Featuring nine JEPs, this milestone focuses on strengthening post-quantum cryptographic security, future language innovations, and advancements in Helidon 27 and JavaFX 27 under the Java Verified Portfolio.

title: Java News Roundup: New OpenJDK JEPs, CDI 5.0, Spring, Open Liberty, RefactorFirst, ADK for Kotlin
author: Michael Redlich
description: Highlights new JEPs for ahead-of-time compilation and structured concurrency; GA releases of Jakarta CDI 5.0 and ADK for Kotlin 1.0; Open Liberty September 2026 edition; point releases of TornadoVM and RefactorFirst; and release candidates of Groovy 6.0 and Gradle 9.8.

title: Java News Roundup: TornadoVM 6, JReleaser, LangChain4j, Java Operator SDK, JHipster, Yupiik Fusion
author: Michael Redlich
description: Features the GA release of TornadoVM 6.0 for hardware-accelerated Java; point releases of JReleaser, LangChain4j for LLM integrations, the Java Operator SDK for Kubernetes, JHipster, and Yupiik Fusion.

title: Java News Roundup: GraalVM, Jakarta Data, JNoSQL, Azul Payara, WildFly, Quarkus, Atmosphere
author: Michael Redlich
description: Highlights the GA release of Atmosphere 4.0; point releases of GraalVM, Azul Payara, and WildFly; and milestones for Jakarta Data, Eclipse JNoSQL, and Quarkus cloud-native runtimes.

title: FlexGanttFX is Open Source
author: Michael Redlich
description: Dirk Lemmermann releases FlexGanttFX as an open-source resource-scheduling framework under the AGPL license, providing Gantt charts, activity grids, and timeline visualizations for JavaFX desktop client applications.

title: Spring News Roundup: First Milestone Releases for Boot, Framework, Data, Security, Modulith, Batch
author: Michael Redlich
description: After a 10-week hiatus, the Spring team releases first milestone builds for Spring Boot 4.0, Spring Framework 7.0, Spring Data, Spring Security, Spring Modulith, and Spring Batch, setting the architectural foundation for the next generation of enterprise Java applications.
